free_tier.stated: The Free Plan is Zeabur's free tier, designed for personal exploration and learning. No credit card required - just sign up and start deploying.

egress.terms: The Free Plan documentation states no monthly byte allowance; it lists only auto-sleep, no SLA, no Zeabur Email, and no backup or log forwarding.; ingress: tcp

interface_detail: Dashboard and CLI; ports declared per service with a type of HTTP or TCP.
tooling: Dashboard, CLI, and templates; port type chosen per service port.
chaining: Zeabur on a self-managed server could open UDP through that server's firewall; the free cloud tier cannot.

limits.value: no published monthly byte allowance on the Free Plan

binding_note: Transport fails first: cloud services offer HTTP or TCP only, and the Free Plan auto-sleeps idle services, which ends a tunnel.

identity_cost.detail: "No credit card required - just sign up and start deploying."

reliability_note: Free Plan services auto-sleep when idle and wake on the next request; a sleeping service cannot hold a tunnel. Forwarded host and port may change.
confidence_note: Whether the Free Plan may attach a TCP port at all is not stated; the plan page limits itself to sleep, SLA and feature exclusions.

evidence.proved: Free Plan, no card, auto-sleep after inactivity, no SLA
"Port Type can be HTTP or TCP" with TCP reachable at an auto-assigned hostname and port
sync-udp 22000/UDP forwarded entry, but "On dedicated server projects this will be your server's public IP"

notes: The UDP evidence in Zeabur's own templates is tied to dedicated-server projects, i.e. a server a user rents elsewhere and attaches. That is not a free platform port. Ports are also documented as possibly changing.

extras.wg_detail: TCP ports only on cloud services: "Port Type can be HTTP or TCP ... TCP ports can be accessed with an auto-assigned hostname and port (e.g., reg.clusters.zeabur.com:12345)". UDP appears only in templates running on dedicated-server projects.
extras.volume_stated: The Free Plan documentation states no monthly byte allowance; it lists only auto-sleep, no SLA, no Zeabur Email, and no backup or log forwarding.
extras.transit_note: Zeabur's cluster ingress forwards TCP to the service.
